script: [serious] Someone poisoned Tylenol, and put it back on the shelf. In the fall of 1982, seven people around Chicago took Extra-Strength Tylenol capsules laced with cyanide. The youngest was twelve. A man named James Lewis mailed Johnson and Johnson a letter demanding one million dollars to stop the killings. He went to prison for extortion. But he was never charged with the murders. The case changed every medicine bottle in America: that seal you peel off exists because of it. The killer has never been found. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number eighteen. A new file every day.
